features.featureTitle:
Add a clearly visible authentication entry point across the app so users can always find where to log in.

- Update the global header (AppHeader) to show:
  - A "Login" button/link when the user is not authenticated that navigates to /login.
  - A "Logout" action when the user is authenticated.
  - Keep existing navigation (Home, Articles, About, Contact) intact.
- Add a prominent "Login" call-to-action on the Home page hero section for unauthenticated users that navigates to /login (in addition to existing Read/Share buttons).

Ensure the admin approval workflow is accessible once the user is authenticated and is an admin.

- Keep the existing admin-only visibility rule for the Admin link, but verify that:
  - The Admin link appears in the header when the authenticated user is an admin.
  - The /admin route continues to render the existing AdminModerationPage and shows the "Awaiting Approval" tab with pending submissions for admins.
  - Non-admins (or logged-out users) continue to see an access denied state on /admin with a login prompt when logged out.
